name: PhotoCraft
short_desc: Browser based photo editor built with Rust and WebAssembly
description: Edit images in your browser with PhotoCraft, an open source photo editor. The web app processes files on your device and downloads saved or exported results to your computer; it does not upload documents to this server. Preferences are stored in your browser. Requires a modern browser with WebGPU or WebGL2; HTTPS enables WebGPU on supported browsers.
author: ArtCraft Team and PhotoCraft contributors
